description.zh: 鼠标靠近按钮时，按钮像被磁铁吸住一样朝光标方向偏移一小段距离， 离开后弹性归位。偏移量按光标与按钮中心的距离计算，通常限制在 8～20px。 一种高"手感"的桌面端彩蛋交互，常出现在作品集与创意官网。
description.en: As the cursor approaches, the button is pulled toward it like iron to a magnet, then springs home on leave. The offset is computed from cursor-to-center distance and usually clamped to 8–20px. A tactile desktop flourish common on portfolios and creative sites.

use_when.zh: 落地页的 CTA、导航图标等少量关键按钮
use_when.en: A few key targets — landing-page CTAs, nav icons

use_when.zh: 创意类 / 作品集网站的品牌调性
use_when.en: Creative or portfolio sites leaning into personality

use_when.zh: 桌面端为主、留白充足的布局
use_when.en: Desktop-first layouts with room to move

avoid_when.zh: 触屏设备（没有 hover，效果失效）
avoid_when.en: Touch devices — no hover, no effect

avoid_when.zh: 表单控件与密集操作区（偏移破坏瞄准）
avoid_when.en: Form controls and dense toolbars — offset ruins aiming

avoid_when.zh: 页面大量按钮全部磁吸（眩晕且廉价）
avoid_when.en: Magnetizing every button on the page — dizzying and cheap

note.zh: 按钮整体向光标平移，最基础
note.en: The whole button translates toward the cursor

note.zh: 文字比外壳多移一档，产生视差
note.en: The label travels further than the shell — parallax

note.zh: 叠加轻微 rotateX/Y，立体感更强

notes.zh: 在按钮（或更大的热区）上监听 mousemove，用 getBoundingClientRect 求光标相对 中心的比例，乘以最大偏移（如 0.3 × 40px）写入 transform: translate； mouseleave 时归零并给 300～500ms 的弹性过渡（cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1.2)）。 进入热区时把 transition 缩短到 100ms 让跟随更"黏"。 触屏直接禁用，配 @media (hover:hover)。
notes.en: Listen for mousemove on a hotspot wrapping the button; derive the cursor's offset ratio from center via getBoundingClientRect, multiply by max travel (e.g. 0.3 × 40px) and write it to `transform: translate`. On mouseleave, return to zero with a springy 300–500ms transition (cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1.2)); shorten to ~100ms while inside so the follow feels sticky. Disable on touch behind @media (hover:hover).

basic.zh: 给按钮添加磁吸效果：鼠标靠近时按钮朝光标方向轻微偏移，离开后弹回。
basic.en: Add a magnetic effect to buttons — the button drifts toward the nearby cursor and springs back on leave.

design.zh: 按钮在光标进入 1.5 倍热区时按比例向光标平移（最大 12px），跟随 100ms、 弹回 400ms 弹性缓动；只用于主 CTA，触屏与键盘操作不受影响。
design.en: Within a 1.5x hotspot the button translates proportionally toward the cursor (max 12px), 100ms follow and a 400ms springy return; reserve for primary CTAs, keep touch and keyboard unaffected.

implementation.zh: React 实现：热区 div 监听 onMouseMove/onMouseLeave，getBoundingClientRect 计算相对中心偏移，setState 驱动 transform: translate(x,y)；内部用 will-change: transform。跟随 100ms、回弹 400ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1.2)。 @media (hover:hover) 门控；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion（禁用偏移）。
implementation.en: React: attach onMouseMove/onMouseLeave to a hotspot div, compute the center-relative offset with getBoundingClientRect, drive `transform: translate(x,y)` from state; add will-change: transform. 100ms follow, 400ms return with cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1.2). Gate behind @media (hover:hover); disable offsets under prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目的主 CTA 按钮添加磁吸交互。

先确认按钮组件结构与强调色令牌，保持一致。
要求：
- 热区 1.5 倍按钮大小，偏移上限 12px，跟随 100ms 弹回 400ms
- 键盘焦点与触屏行为不受影响
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add a magnetic interaction to the project's primary CTA buttons.

Confirm button component structure and accent tokens first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Hotspot 1.5x button size; offset capped at 12px; 100ms follow, 400ms spring
- Keyboard focus and touch behavior unaffected
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
